scenarios.title: Burned and registered; no payment yet, before the due time
scenarios.rationale: Due 2026-10-07T10:00Z, clock 2026-10-06T09:00Z: absence is not yet a breach.

scenarios.title: Full redemption settled on time
scenarios.rationale: Request, approved price, position before acceptance, USD 10,000.00 paid 2026-10-06T15:00Z, TA debit and burn of 100: every control passes with coverage.

scenarios.title: Payment effective exactly at the due time
scenarios.rationale: A payment effective exactly at the due instant is on time.

scenarios.title: No payment after the due time, with full bank coverage
scenarios.rationale: The bank export [2026-10-04T00:00Z, 2026-10-07T12:00Z) for the account in USD, unfiltered, contains the due instant: absence of the payment is demonstrated.

scenarios.title: RD-MISSED replayed after the late payment arrived
scenarios.rationale: Same closed snapshot as RD-MISSED consulted after RD-LATE: the late payment is not a member, so the history reproduces.

scenarios.title: Bank coverage stops a day early
scenarios.rationale: The bank export ends 2026-10-06T00:00Z: absence cannot be demonstrated.

scenarios.title: Bank coverage ends exactly at the due time
scenarios.rationale: Coverage intervals are half-open: [.., 2026-10-07T10:00Z) excludes the due instant, when an on-time payment could still be effective.

scenarios.title: Bank coverage declares a gap
scenarios.rationale: A declared gap (2026-10-06T12:00Z-13:00Z) means the export is incomplete.

scenarios.title: Payment arrives after the due time
scenarios.rationale: USD 10,000.00 effective 2026-10-08T09:00Z, 23 hours late: settlement completes and the breach of the deadline persists.

scenarios.title: TA declares another due time; not yet due either way
scenarios.rationale: payment_due_at 2026-10-07T17:00Z disagrees with accepted_at + 48h: a data conflict, not a financial breach.

scenarios.title: TA declares another due time; no payment by the computed one
scenarios.rationale: accepted_at is credited, so the payment is judged against the computed due time (10:00Z): missed, with coverage. The data conflict stays visible as UNKNOWN.

scenarios.title: Payment on time but USD 50.00 short
Request states another price
scenarios.rationale: The request says USD 101.00; the approved price for its price_ref is 100.00.

scenarios.title: Expected payment not exact at the cash scale
scenarios.rationale: 100.0000001 units x USD 100.00 = 10,000.00001: not representable at scale 2.

scenarios.title: Requested units exceed the available position
scenarios.rationale: 100 units requested; 50 available immediately before acceptance (sequence 1004).

scenarios.title: Older position rebuilt from the TA journal
scenarios.rationale: Position 1,000 at sequence 900 + 50 (J-0950) - 30 reserved by RED-0000 (J-0960) = 1,020 available before acceptance (1005). The request's own reservation (J-1006) is after it and is not subtracted twice.

scenarios.title: Rebuilt position is insufficient
scenarios.rationale: 120 held at sequence 900, 40 reserved by RED-0000 at 961: 80 available, 20 short.

scenarios.title: Older position without coverage to rebuild it
scenarios.rationale: The TA export starts 2026-10-05T00:00Z, after the position (2026-10-04T18:00Z): the journal between them is not demonstrated complete. No age window replaces it.

scenarios.title: Position and acceptance share a journal sequence
scenarios.rationale: Same timestamp and same sequence: nothing orders the position before the acceptance.

scenarios.title: Linked burn effective before acceptance
scenarios.rationale: The burn (09:30Z) precedes acceptance (10:00Z): the link is kept, but it does not fulfil the retirement in this profile.

scenarios.title: Cancelled before any settlement, full coverage
scenarios.rationale: Authorized cancellation effective 2026-10-05T11:00Z; no payment or burn with bank and chain coverage to valid_at. MATCH rests on the two cancellation controls. Profile 1.6.0 (INV-015): the chain certificate declares no chain scope, so it cannot show that no burn occurred; the absence of settlement is UNKNOWN (INSUFFICIENT_COVERAGE).

scenarios.title: Cancelled, but bank coverage stops early
scenarios.rationale: Without bank coverage to valid_at the absence of settlement is not demonstrated.

scenarios.title: Cancelled, yet the payment was made
scenarios.rationale: Payment linked to a cancelled request: review required, nothing reversed.

scenarios.title: Cancelled, yet the units were burned
scenarios.rationale: Burn linked to a cancelled request: review required, nothing reversed.

scenarios.title: Cancellation effective after a missed due time
scenarios.rationale: Effective 2026-10-08T00:00Z, after the due time passed without payment: it extinguishes what was pending but not the demonstrated breach. Profile 1.6.0 (INV-015): the chain certificate declares no chain scope, so it cannot show that no burn occurred; the absence of settlement is UNKNOWN (INSUFFICIENT_COVERAGE); the missed payment keeps the BREAK.

scenarios.title: Snapshot before a late-delivered cancellation
scenarios.rationale: At 2026-10-07T12:00Z nothing showed a cancellation and the payment was missed with coverage: BREAK was justified by the evidence then, and replays so.

scenarios.title: Cancellation effective before the due time, known after
scenarios.rationale: Effective 2026-10-06T08:00Z (before the due time) though recorded 2026-10-07T15:00Z: the current conclusion for the period changes; the earlier snapshot keeps its BREAK. Profile 1.6.0 (INV-015): the chain certificate declares no chain scope, so it cannot show that no burn occurred; the absence of settlement is UNKNOWN (INSUFFICIENT_COVERAGE).

scenarios.title: Cancellation by an unauthorized party
scenarios.rationale: Not a cancellation authority: the obligations are not extinguished.

scenarios.title: Snapshot while the cancellation stood
scenarios.rationale: At 2026-10-05T11:30Z the cancellation was in force and nothing had settled. Profile 1.6.0 (INV-015): the chain certificate declares no chain scope, so it cannot show that no burn occurred; the absence of settlement is UNKNOWN (INSUFFICIENT_COVERAGE).

scenarios.title: Cancellation retracted as an evidence correction
scenarios.rationale: The TA retracts revision 1 of CAN-RED-0001 with revision 2: no cancellation in force, with TA coverage. Obligations are judged again against the original due time.

scenarios.title: Retraction and another revision 2 disagree
scenarios.rationale: Two revision-2 deliveries of the cancellation record differ: no choice is made.

scenarios.title: A cancelled request is reactivated
scenarios.rationale: Business reactivation is outside this profile version.

scenarios.title: The TA retracts the request record
scenarios.rationale: Withdrawing the evidence of the request is not a cancellation: loss of support.

scenarios.title: Request retracted after the payment was made
scenarios.rationale: Dependent controls lose support; the payment stays effective and is cited, not erased.

scenarios.title: Linked payment made to another account
scenarios.rationale: PAY-RED-0001 is linked to RED-0001 but paid to acct-pseudo-0002; bank and TA share the account namespace in DEMO-A, so the wrong recipient is demonstrated.

scenarios.title: Unlinked payment carrying the instructed settlement_ref
scenarios.rationale: The TA instructed settlement_ref PAY-RED-0001 and an unlinked payment carries it: a relevant candidate without an approved link. Neither paid nor missed.

scenarios.title: Unlinked payment to the same account, no candidate
scenarios.rationale: Sharing the account is not a candidate association: the unlinked payment neither settles RED-0001 nor makes it ambiguous, and the linked payment is missed.

scenarios.title: Payment effective after the economic cut
scenarios.rationale: valid_at 2026-10-06T12:00Z: the 15:00Z payment is known but not yet effective at the economic cut, and the due time has not passed.

scenarios.title: Clock after the due time, economic cut before it
scenarios.rationale: Clock 2026-10-07T12:00Z but valid_at 09:00Z: the economic cut does not reach the due time (10:00Z, unchanged), so absence cannot be judged.

scenarios.title: Bank export filtered to the account and currency
scenarios.rationale: Filtering by the requesting account and USD keeps every record the absence predicate needs: the missed payment is still demonstrated.

scenarios.title: Bank export filtered by status
scenarios.rationale: A status filter cannot be shown to keep every relevant payment or revision: absence is not demonstrated.

scenarios.title: Cancelled, and a linked burn effective before acceptance
scenarios.rationale: The early burn does not fulfil the retirement, but it happened (successful, linked, effective): it contradicts the clean cancellation.

scenarios.title: Short payment, before the bank's correction is known
scenarios.rationale: At 2026-10-06T16:00Z only revision 1 (USD 9,950.00) is known.

scenarios.title: Correction known after valid_at of an earlier payment
scenarios.rationale: Revision 2 (USD 10,000.00, effective 2026-10-06T15:00Z) is recorded 2026-10-07T11:00Z, after valid_at 16:00Z of the 6th but within the knowledge snapshot: it describes the earlier economic fact and counts.

scenarios.title: Two payments carry the instructed settlement_ref
scenarios.rationale: An unlinked payment and one linked to RED-0002 both carry PAY-RED-0001: the collision stays visible and nothing is associated.

scenarios.title: The bank delivers the same payment twice
scenarios.rationale: Identical redelivery of PAY-RED-0001 rev 1 counts once.
